messages:
sylvia: kicking off intake for orchID 'orchid-3b-v2' — goal: onboard to hosted + dedicated with quantized variants. primary concerns: latency p95 <= 300ms hosted, quality delta <= 1.5% on our eval suite, and safe private deploy packaging. please ack ownership for perf, eval, infra, and rollout.

mohit: i can own perf benchmarks and canary signals. planning baseline runs on slab cluster (slab-ux1) today. will produce p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, and mem usage.

tara: i'll run evals + regression checks. i'll run our standard eval harness (summaries, codegen, conv QA) and add a short prompt set for hallucination patterns.

sylvia: thx. priority ordering: 1) correctness (regressions) 2) latency for customer routes 3) cost/unit. if quant removes quality, fallback to higher-precision variant.

theo: for quant experiments i'll try int8 + awq-int4 profiles. initial configs:
```
quant_profiles:
  - name: int8-default
    bits: 8
    kernels: fp16-emulate
  - name: awq-int4-fast
    bits: 4
    strategy: per-channel
```
I'll attach the quant eval diffs by EOD. note: int4 may need larger KV-cache tuning.

maya: for private deploy implications: packaging must include model artifacts + conversion log + KMS key id stub. Also check network egress configs for customer sites. i'll own private deploy checklist.

devops-bot: scheduled maintenance window suggestion: 2026-06-11 02:00-04:00 UTC for canary ramp. automated smoke job configured: slab-smoke-orchid-3b -> runs warmup tokens=2000, perf loop=1m.

mohit: initial baseline numbers on slab-ux1 (raw): p50=78ms, p95=260ms, p99=410ms, throughput=320 tokens/s. int8 seems promising p95 ~ 220ms. will run warmup with prefix caching.

tara: early evals: rouge / em / codegen pass rates roughly -0.8% relative to baseline fp16. hallucination tests unchanged. i'll expand prompt set to edge-cases list from support.

sylvia: ok good. rollout plan draft:
- smoke on slab (internal) -> green
- canary hosted 2% for 30m (verify errors <1%, p95 < 350ms)
- ramp to 10% over 2h if stable
- dedicated reserve: stage in dev pool, then mirror traffic 30m, then switch
- private: package + run local smoke + sign-off

failover policy: immediate traffic shift to orchid-3b-fp16 if errors >1.5% or latency breach > 400ms for >5m.

theo: add autoscaling hooks: warmup tokens=1500, min_replicas=2 for hosted canary, continuous batch length cap=256 to avoid memory spikes.

mohit: alerting:
- perf-alert if p95 increase >20% vs baseline for 10m
- error-rate alert if request_error_rate > 0.8% sustained 5m
- quality regression alert from eval bot if metric drop >1.0% on rolling prompt set

maya: docs needed for on-prem: conversion steps, HSM/KMS mapping, required docker images, and an upgrade safety checklist. i'll draft.

sylvia: owners: perf=mohit, evals=tara, quant=theo, private=maya, release coordination=sylvia. please post short sign-off when you complete your checklists. i'll merge into rollout RFC afterwards.

tara: ack. i'll post eval diffs by 2001257400.

theo: ack — quant artifacts + fastconfig pushed to /mnt/quant-artifacts/orchid-3b/ by EOD.

mohit: starting canary warmup now. will update if any regressions.

sylvia: thanks all. one more ask — include a small prompt-set (10 examples) labelled 'smoke-token-priming' to exercise KV cache; ideally from real customer traffic anonymized. maya — can you confirm consent/filters for private packs? :slightly_smiling_face:

maya: yes, will confirm filters and send stub license + scrub process.

devops-bot: canary job started: job_id=canary-2001256799, monitor at /deploys/canary-2001256799

mohit: canary first 5m: errors 0.06%, p95=235ms. continuing.

sylvia: great. keep thread updated, and paste final checklist when complete. thanks!
